Dataset Metadata Repository

This folder contains metadata and documentation describing the datasets used in the AquaSense AI groundwater study.

Datasets documented:

1. USGS NWIS Groundwater Observations
2. Sentinel-1 SAR
3. Sentinel-2 Surface Reflectance
4. Landsat 8 Collection 2 Level 2
5. NASA SRTM DEM
6. NASA POWER Weather Data
7. ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0

Metadata fields to be documented include:

- Dataset name
- Data provider
- Source/platform
- Dataset ID
- Spatial coverage
- Temporal coverage
- Spatial resolution
- Variables/bands
- Units
- Coordinate reference system
- Access method
- Intended use in the project
